ckks.scorer_context_keys: Galois keys only (no secret, public or relinearisation keys)

latency_ms.note: steady_state: steps as timed inside the bank service (includes the bank -> scorer HTTP hop). client_round_trip: POST /apply timed by this script, so two HTTP hops (client -> bank -> scorer). 'first_request' includes registering the public context with the scorer and is excluded from the medians and p95s. The plaintext baseline is in-process (no HTTP).

scorer_compute.note: compute_ms from the scorer's GET /activity, read every 40 rows and combined by fingerprint; covers all 300 rows

size_bytes.plaintext_json_note: compact JSON {pseudonym, features}: what the bank would send without HE
